The **ML Layers** group of the node palette has 6 nodes: all run.

| Node | Status | What it does |
| --- | --- | --- |
| [Conv1D](../ml-layers/conv1d.md) | Runs | 1-D convolution over a sequence: [L, C] -> [L_out, filters]. |
| [Conv2D](../ml-layers/conv2d.md) | Runs | 2D convolution over an image feature map. |
| [Conv3D](../ml-layers/conv3d.md) | Runs | 3D convolution over a volume sample [D, H, W, C]. |
| [Dense](../ml-layers/dense.md) | Runs | Linear projection over the final input dimension. |
| [Depthwise Conv2D](../ml-layers/depthwise-conv2d.md) | Runs | Convolves each channel with its own kernels: [H,W,C] -> [H',W',C x depth_multiplier]. |
| [Embedding](../ml-layers/embedding.md) | Runs | Look up trainable dense vectors for exact integer token IDs. |
